info.name: TDR Backend E2E — Auth · Create · DRC · NewDRCOfOwner · Transfer · Utilization · History
info.description:
End-to-end Postman collection for the TDR backend.

Flow:
1. **0 Auth — Login** to fetch `apiKey` (auto-saved into collection variable `apiKey`).
2. **1 Create TDR** — sends `rid` from request body (frontend-provided) and saves `application_id`, `tdrApplicationId`, `samagra_id`, `rid` into collection variables.
3. **2 Upload DRC (multipart)** — sets project status to `DRC_GENERATED`. Attach two local files (`form4`, `drc_certificate`).
4. **3 NewDRCOfOwner** — adds another DRC certificate entry for the same owner (and updates project DRC fields).
5. **4 Transfer** — creates the recipient/independent owner row with the **same RID** as the source. Saves `recipient_application_id`, `recipient_rid`, `new_owner_application_id` into collection variables.
6. **5 Utilization** — utilises some TDR/area from the source owner row.
7. **6 History (read)** — every read API for Mongo + blockchain history.

Variables:
- `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:3000`)
- `apiKey` (auto-filled by Login test script)
- `userId`, `password` (used by Login)
- `application_id`, `tdrApplicationId`, `rid`, `samagra_id`, `recipient_application_id`, `recipient_rid`, `recipient_samagra_id`, `drc_id`, `drc_certificate_no` (auto-filled or pre-populated)

Auth header: every protected request sends `x-api-key: {{apiKey}}` via collection-level auth.

request.description: Login to receive an apiKey. The test script auto-saves `data.apiKey` into the collection variable `apiKey` and every subsequent request uses it via the `x-api-key` header.

201 response sets `application_id`, `tdrApplicationId`, `rid`, `samagra_id` into collection variables via the Tests script.

Important: `rid` is sent by frontend/client in request body. Backend does not generate RID on create. `samagra_id` is part of `owner` in the request and is also echoed at the top level of the response for convenience.
Pick two local files for `form4` and `drc_certificate`. Project status moves to `DRC_GENERATED` and a `pushUpdateAsset` blockchain event is recorded.

Adds a new DRC entry for the selected application + Samagra owner. Lookup is by `application_id` + `samagra_id`.

This API also makes the application DRC-ready (same as `2 Upload DRC`):
- sets `project.drc_id`, `project.drc_certificate_no`, `project.drc_generation_dt`
- sets `project.status = 'DRC_GENERATED'`
- sets `documents.drc_certificate` (using `drc_certificate_doc_path` as `file_url` + auto hash)

After calling this, **Transfer (4)** and **Utilization (5)** for the same `application_id` + `samagra_id` will succeed (no more `DRC_NOT_READY`).

Duplicate checks:
- same `drc_certificate_no` reused for same `samagra_id` → 409 `DRC_CERTIFICATE_REUSE`
- same `drc_id` reused for same `samagra_id` → 409 `DRC_ID_REUSE`

Requires DRC ready on source (use `2 Upload DRC` or have `project.status = DRC_GENERATED` / `ACTIVE` + DRC document). Optional `trn_value_tdr` overrides auto valuation (= `collector_guideline_rate * multiplier_factor * transferred_area`).

Important: the recipient row uses the **same RID** as the source — `recipient_rid === source_rid`. The recipient is created as an independent application with its own `application_id` and `tdrApplicationId`.

body.raw:
{
  "application_id": "{{application_id}}",
  "samagra_id": "{{samagra_id}}",
  "utilization_id": "UTIL-{{$timestamp}}",
  "drc_id": "{{drc_id}}",
  "drc_certificate_no": "{{drc_certificate_no}}",
  "utilized_by": "Rajesh Kumar",
  "utilized_area": 50,
  "utilization_purpose": "Road Development",
  "utilization_date": "2026-05-11T10:00:00.000Z",
  "status": "COMPLETED",
  "remarks": "TDR utilized for government project"
}

request.description: Run against the source owner row before/after transfer, or adjust `application_id` / `samagra_id` for the row you want to consume. Optional `utilized_value_tdr` overrides auto valuation.
Full Mongo document for this `application_id` + `owner.samagra_id`, with derived balances (`total_tdr_value`, `transfer_tdr_value`, `utilized_tdr_value`, `remaining_tdr_value`).
Chain `getHistory` / asset history + area/TDR summary for this application.

item.name: GET all applications + chain history each

request.description: Every application row: `samagra_id`, `source_application_id`, transfers/utilizations counts, area/TDR summary, blockchain history.

item.name: GET all DRC by RID (one API for RID → DRC)

request.description: Single API: pass an RID and get every Mongo row (source + every recipient) for that RID with DRC fields (`drc_id`, `drc_certificate_no`, `drc_generation_dt`, `drc_certificate` document, status, balances, samagra_id, owner_name).

item.name: GET all DRC by RID — recipient RID

request.description: Same endpoint hit with `recipient_rid` — useful to confirm that the recipient row reuses the same RID as the source after a transfer. Both calls should return the same RID/data set.

item.name: GET all history by RID (Mongo + chain)

request.description: Per application sharing this RID: ledger, transfers, utilizations, area/TDR summary, owner, plus chain `getHistory` per app.
Each transfer event with `samagra_id`, `owner_name`, `source_application_id`, and correct area/TDR summary.
Each utilization with `samagra_id`, `owner_name`, `source_application_id`, and correct area/TDR summary.
All rows with any DRC metadata (drc_id / drc_certificate_no / drc_certificate document) + samagra_id.
Single application snapshot for this `project.drc_id` (transfers/utilizations arrays stripped from the response).
